t: This is the site of the Malatesta Club, an anarchist social club that ran in London from 1954 to 1958. It took its name from Errico Malatesta, the Italian anarchist who spent much of his life in exile and in prison, expelled from several countries. The club was founded by three people: Donald Rooum, an anarchist cartoonist and writer, Philip Sansom, an anarchist, orator and printer, and Rufus Segar, an illustrator who designed the covers of the magazine Anarchy for ten years.
